localPasses.evidence: Route tests cover pre-body auth failure, library manager denial, project edit denial, estimate-row project/estimate edit denial, and no storage writes before denial.

Policy registry, provider-neutral object key builder, upload asset/session RPC contract, provider adapter contract, path constraints, and narrow RLS/grants are covered by upload-domain and provider tests.

Happy-path route tests now cover project image, component image, and estimate-row image storage plus atomic upload asset records. Malicious fixture tests cover oversized content-length, MIME/magic mismatch, empty files, fake XLSX, stale estimate rows, workspace-mismatched resolvers, and no storage/RPC work after rejection.

Linked Supabase provider readback for project ebxxqidacheyapmmzavr lists the five upload migrations, confirms upload_sessions/upload_assets/upload_events exist with RLS enabled, confirms authenticated-only upload table SELECT policies, confirms upload scan lifecycle enum labels and function grants, and finds none of the known broad direct storage policies present. Static migration contract drops broad direct project-image/component-image/component-attachment write/update/delete policies and pending component-attachment direct-read policy.
Approval/supersede RPCs fail closed until scanning exists; attachment download broker exists but refuses files unless the matching upload asset is finalized and scan-clean.

GET /api/component-library/attachments?id=... validates the attachment workspace, requires library-manager authorization, requires a matching finalized upload_assets row with scan_status=clean, audits download_url_issued before storage download, returns no-store failures, and never reaches storage for pending/unscanned assets.

Additive migration extends upload_scan_status with failed_transient, failed_permanent, and override_approved alongside existing pending, clean, infected, and unsupported states; current attachment downloads still allow only scan_status=clean.
In-process closed-beta rate and active-upload caps return 429 with Retry-After; actor-bound rate tests cover rotating x-forwarded-for attempts.

Upload cleanup planner only emits provider cleanup targets for failed/deleted/expired records or expired reserved sessions, rejects finalized assets and unsafe workspace/path/bucket shapes, dedupes thumbnails, and summarizes removed/failed/rejected counts without provider secrets.

Cleanup operations now produce explicit failed/deleted/expired-session/audit retention cutoffs, retry-after guidance for failed provider deletes, dashboard-safe cleanup metrics, and warning/critical backlog alerts without exposing storage paths or provider internals.

Estimate-row reference image DOM tests cover estimate-scoped upload FormData, selected/uploading/error/cancel/retry states, stale abort isolation, Escape/overlay guard, alert/status roles, and returned URL commit.

Estimate-row uploads require row scope, return imageAsset descriptors, commit descriptors through the row editor, validate/canonicalize descriptors through validate_estimate_row_image_asset before update_estimate_row_item_with_history, reject tampered descriptors, and carry descriptors through project-component projection metadata.

Estimate-row reference images now write to the private project-images bucket under project-scoped project-images/{projectId}/estimate-row-images/{estimateId}/ paths, return /api/projects/images resolver URLs, and validate upload_assets as surface=project-image, target_entity_type=estimate-row, target_entity_id=projectId with row metadata.

New component-library image uploads return /api/component-library/images resolver URLs instead of Supabase public URLs; resolver tests cover workspace-gated private GET, workspace mismatch denial, no-store fail-closed malformed paths, and no .getPublicUrl(path) in broker routes.

Local backfill classifier distinguishes asset-backed descriptors, brokered private resolver URLs, local derivatives, legacy public component-images URLs needing private-resolver backfill, and unsafe/external references requiring manual review across component library, estimate-row source snapshots, and publication snapshots.

Linked provider aggregate scan found zero persisted legacy public component-image URLs, zero upload_assets component-image records, and zero publication/version snapshot image rows in project ebxxqidacheyapmmzavr; three estimate-row image references remain non-provider/external snapshot references. See evidence/upload-component-image-provider-scan.json.

Linked provider storage catalog readback confirms component-images public=false, the old component images are publicly readable SELECT policy is absent, and no remaining storage.objects policies reference component-images in project ebxxqidacheyapmmzavr. See evidence/upload-component-image-private-bucket-readback.json.

Scanner lifecycle module and migration contracts define attachment-only scan requirements, clean/pending/infected/unsupported/transient/permanent/override decisions, queue backpressure classification, service-role-only scanner-result RPC, and audited override RPC with actor, reason, expiry, and checksum requirements. The current download broker still only serves scan-clean files.

blockers.reason: Linked provider readback confirms the known broad direct storage policies are absent, but direct write/update/delete/download denial operations are still skipped until ARCH_UPLOAD_STORAGE_PROOF=1 and scoped Supabase test credentials are configured.

Fail-closed audited download broker, safe response headers, scan-status taxonomy, local scan lifecycle decisions, and service-role scanner/override RPC contracts exist locally, but the scanner/CDR provider, queue worker, real clean/failure transitions, provider-backed clean download proof, and operational override workflow are not implemented.

Local cleanup planning, retention cutoffs, retry guidance, dashboard-safe metrics, backlog alerts, and scanner backpressure classifiers exist, but durable scheduled TTL cleanup, provider-backed retry/audit execution, real dashboard emission, quota alerts, production backpressure hooks, and an exercised retention runbook are not complete.
Only local Sharp smoke evidence exists; hosted body-size, memory, duration, concurrency, and storage-latency proof is still required.

Asset-descriptor migration parity contracts normalize upload asset descriptors, brokered private component/project image URLs, and legacy public component-image URLs into provider-neutral bucket/path locators; unsafe URLs and descriptor/URL mismatches remain manual-review only.
